intent.text: Yes, with my conditions from r4 on the record: any action with no verified CC_AGENT is marked as an identity gap; vsect checks the key and src tag rather than reading the raw variable; adversarial tests run in the live harness before any project-scoped rule is relied on; and the trial record shows which run had the prefix refused. Sec's amendment (project rule provisional until tests pass) is one I support.
